name: HA Health Sync
subtitle: Health data for Home Assistant
description:
Synchronize selected Apple Health data directly with your Home Assistant through Health Bridge. Manual sync is free, including setup, metric selection, Health permissions, and in-app Sync Now. A one-time lifetime unlock enables automatic background sync, all Shortcuts sync, and historical imports. No subscription. The app displays your App Store price and offers Restore Purchases.

Historical import includes legacy bounded backfill and, on iOS 27 with a compatible Health Bridge fork and approved phone ownership, original-sample import. Original-sample import makes a durable copy of selected originals in your Home Assistant archive with no automatic expiration. Local reset, Health permission changes, and loss of purchase access do not erase that archive; manage export, deletion, and backups in Home Assistant.

Your health data travels directly between this iPhone and the Home Assistant instance you configure. The developer receives no health data and operates no purchase account, analytics, advertising, remote logging, or cloud database. Apple handles purchases through the App Store.

Requires iOS 18 or later, Home Assistant, and Health Bridge. Background synchronization is best effort and controlled by iOS. Purchase does not grant Health permissions or guarantee background delivery.
